properties.site-address: Edmonton Green North Mall Car Park
properties.notes: Erection of a 9-storey block to provide 77 residential units (comprising 32 x 1 bed, 44 x 2 bed and 1 x 3 bed to provide 77 units and 5 x 3 bed to provide 5 family units) with balconies to front and rear elevations and solar panels to roof involving reduction in parking spaces and the reconfiguration of car park, conversion of vacant first floor commercial space (Class B1) to provide 5 x 3-bed residential units with amenity deck and refurbishment of North Mall retail thoroughfare.
properties.ownership-status: not owned by a public authority
